clue.text: Cleaning item rusted badly

indicators.note: badly signals that the letters of rusted are put together wrongly, in a new order

explanation.surface: A cleaning cloth has been ruined by rust stains.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloth used for wiping away dust is a household cleaning implement.

clue.text: Prosper initially over in lodge

indicators.note: in signals that the first piece is placed inside the second

parts.note: to lodge somewhere is to dwell there

indicators.note: initially picks out just the opening letter of the word over

explanation.surface: Someone thrives at first, then moves into a lodge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts O, the first letter of 'over', inside DWELL.
explanation.definitionFit: To prosper is to succeed or thrive, an idiomatic sense of doing well.

clue.text: Old comedian's second fish factory Gina organised

definitions.note: the 's stands for 'is', linking the definition to the wordplay

parts.note: a pike is a freshwater fish
a mill is a factory

indicators.note: organised signals that the letters of Gina are arranged into a different order

explanation.surface: A comedian's second business is a fish factory run by someone called Gina.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organised' turns GINA into IGAN. Spike Milligan was a British comic, famed for The Goon Show radio series.
explanation.definitionFit: Spike Milligan, who died in 2002, was a celebrated Irish-British comic writer and performer.

clue.text: English mine with the odd descriptive term

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine

indicators.note: odd signals that the word the is rearranged, its letters made strange

explanation.definitionFit: An epithet is a characterising word or phrase attached to a name, such as 'the Great'.

clue.text: Play on words to dig somewhere in India

a dig is a poke or jab

explanation.surface: A pun is made, followed by a sharp remark about some place in India.
explanation.definitionFit: The Punjab is a state in northern India, also a province of Pakistan.

clue.text: Vessel that was submersible but buoyant at regular intervals

indicators.note: at regular intervals means taking every other letter of the words but buoyant

explanation.surface: A boat that could dive yet still float on the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The German submarines of the two World Wars were submersible warships.

clue.text: Landscape painter's private room with PC

explanation.walkthrough: 'john' is American slang for a toilet.

clue.text: Creature consumes right cut of meat

parts.note: a beast is a creature

clue.text: Suffer in part of aircraft, crying loudly

parts.note: a wing is part of an aircraft

clue.text: Biscuit barrel upside-down below item on spice rack?

parts.note: ginger is a spice kept on a rack; the query flags an example

parts.note: a tun is a large barrel for wine or beer

explanation.definitionFit: A gingernut is a hard, crunchy British biscuit flavoured with ginger.

clue.text: Brownish-yellow section of brooch revealed

clue.text: Observes twitching inside damaged nose

clue.text: Location of travelling ocean liner, generally

clue.text: Desire for wealth pilot's seen around two eastern US states

clue.text: Mostly hairless oddball inflated plaything

clue.text: Greek character old and huge

clue.text: Modify church table, one says

clue.text: A golfer may register this bird of prey

clue.text: Combatant's helmet that restricts batting

clue.text: Member to conclude traditional story
